The '''Odacer-Faustin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located in the [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odacer-Faustin]], which was the site of a [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] in the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="RH" />
